decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason (Condition 4)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 4 (refuse and recycling) of planning permission of planning permission 00657/B/P19 dated 20/6/2011 for 'Erection of 87 affordable housing units as a variation to approved schemes 00657/B/P15 and 00657/B/P15(C)', are satisfactory, meeting the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.2.4 (Recycling Facilities in New Developments) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Reason (Condition 5)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 5 (cycle storage) of planning permission of planning permission 00657/B/P19 dated 20/6/2011 for 'Erection of 87 affordable housing units as a variation to approved schemes 00657/B/P15 and 00657/B/P15(C)', are satisfactory, meeting the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Reason (Condition 7)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 7 (wheelchair housing) of planning permission of planning permission 00657/B/P19 dated 20/6/2011 for 'Erection of 87 affordable housing units as a variation to approved schemes 00657/B/P15 and 00657/B/P15(C)', are satisfactory, meeting the requirements of the condition and policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Details of waste and recycling submitted pursuant to condition 4,  cycle parking pursuant to condition 5, and wheelchair units pursuant to condition 7 following approval 00657/B/P19 dated 20.06.2011 for 'Erection of 87 affordable housing units as a variation to approved schemes 00657/B/P15 and 00657/B/P15(C)'.
